audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the first five Seed Shop event records: both Prairie King outcomes, Abigail’s spirit-board scene, Pierre’s secret-stash choice, and the Caroline-Abigail argument. Every line, embedded question, response option, conditional and gender branch, symbol sequence, game title, family meaning, and character voice was reviewed in full event context with canonical Abigail, Caroline, Pierre and Journey of the Prairie King terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship and prior-choice conditions, response IDs, placeholders, Latin letters and symbols, branch delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining Seed Shop records are handled separately. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
